QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_41

question.text: Under SAS-500, 'forest conservation' outcome indicators should be MEASURED using:

answer.text: Remote-sensing / satellite imagery analysis (NDVI change) + ground-truthing plots + forest department records + biodiversity proxy counts

explanation.text: The Logic: Satellite NDVI (vegetation index) + ground-truthing plots + forest-department records + biodiversity proxy (species count, bird call index) is the standard multi-layer evidence design for forest indicators under SAS-500. The Trap: Options B, C, D are single-source or irrelevant. Cross-Exam Context: Remote-sensing evidence also used in SEBI BRSR disclosure (III-A / III-C Compliance) and insurance claim assessment (XV Research Analyst). Assessor's Pro-Tip: Use free satellite data — Sentinel-2 and Google Earth Engine provide NDVI time-series at no cost. A 30-minute NDVI check can confirm or refute an afforestation claim.
